_source.name: Registo de planos/programas especiais de ordenamento do território (PEOT) — compilado de APA, ICNF, DGT/PCGT e DRE
_source.note: Inventário verificado (jul 2026): POAAP/PEAAP (albufeiras), POOC/POC (orla costeira), POE (estuários — nenhum aprovado), POAP/PEAP (áreas protegidas), PSRN2000. Estados voláteis — re-verificar PCGT/DRE periodicamente.

instruments.status: revoked (Mar 2026) — protection now under the statutory DL 107/2009 regime, no replacement programa especial
instruments.notes: RCM 52/2026 explicitly states a special-nature IGT is no longer needed; DL 107/2009 regime applies. NOT a transposition-into-PDM case.

instruments.notes: One of the original 9 POOCs. Revision into a POC determined by despacho of 2009.

instruments.name: POOC Ovar-Marinha Grande — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Ovar-Marinha Grande
instruments.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Ovar-Marinha Grande (RCM n.º 112/2017)
instruments.notes: First POOC to be converted into a Programa da Orla Costeira.

instruments.name: POOC Alcobaça-Mafra — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Alcobaça-Mafra
instruments.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel (RCM n.º 66/2019)

instruments.name: POOC Cidadela-Forte de São Julião da Barra — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Cidadela-São Julião da Barra
instruments.diploma: RCM n.º 123/98, de 19 de outubro; alterado pelas RCM n.º 82/2012 e RCM n.º 64/2016, de 19 de outubro
instruments.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel (RCM n.º 66/2019)
instruments.notes: Shortest POOC (Cascais bay marginal, Cidadela to Forte de S. Julião da Barra).

instruments.name: POOC Sintra-Sado — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Sintra-Sado
instruments.status: Revoked in two steps: area north of Cabo Espichel by POC Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel (RCM 66/2019); Espichel-Sado section by POC Espichel-Odeceixe (RCM 87-A/2022). Fully out of force since October 2022.
instruments.notes: Its area was split between two POC troços at Cabo Espichel.

instruments.name: POOC Sado-Sines — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Sado-Sines
instruments.status: Revoked — replaced by POC Espichel-Odeceixe (RCM n.º 87-A/2022)
instruments.notes: Covered the Tróia-Sines arc.

instruments.name: POOC Sines-Burgau — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Sines-Burgau
instruments.status: PARTIALLY in force: the Sines-Odeceixe section was replaced by POC Espichel-Odeceixe (RCM 87-A/2022); the Odeceixe-Burgau section remains in force until the POC Odeceixe-Vilamoura is approved (still in elaboration as of mid-2026).
instruments.notes: IMPORTANT overlap for pdm: this entire stretch lies inside the Parque Natural do Sudoeste Alentejano e Costa Vicentina — the POPNSACV (RCM n.º 11-B/2011, de 4 de fevereiro) applies concurrently; municipal PDMs transpose both regimes.

instruments.name: POOC Burgau-Vilamoura — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Burgau-Vilamoura
instruments.status: STILL IN FORCE (em vigor) — will be replaced by POC Odeceixe-Vilamoura, which is still in elaboration as of mid-2026
instruments.notes: One of only two POOCs still fully in force.

instruments.name: POOC Vilamoura-Vila Real de Santo António — Plano de Ordenamento da Orla Costeira Vilamoura-Vila Real de Santo António
instruments.diploma: RCM n.º 103/2005, de 27 de junho; 1.ª alteração pela RCM n.º 65/2016, de 19 de outubro (regulamento arts. 3, 4, 23, 55, 58-61, 67-77, 93, 95 + planta síntese)
instruments.status: STILL IN FORCE (em vigor) — replacement POC-VVRSA has not effectively started (PCGT: 'a aguardar atribuição')
instruments.notes: Covers the Ria Formosa barrier-island coast; overlaps the Parque Natural da Ria Formosa special plan (POPNRF).

instruments.name: POC-CE — Programa da Orla Costeira Caminha-Espinho
instruments.status: Em vigor (in force). Revokes POOC Caminha-Espinho (RCM 25/99 + RCM 154/2007).
instruments.notes: 122 km of coast, 9 municipalities, 36 freguesias. As a 'programa' it binds public entities; its faixas de salvaguarda and beach regulations were transposed into PDMs (e.g. PDM Caminha alteration, Aviso 22303/2021).

instruments.name: POC-OMG — Programa da Orla Costeira Ovar-Marinha Grande
instruments.diploma: RCM n.º 112/2017, de 10 de agosto; Regulamento de Gestão das Praias Marítimas: Aviso n.º 11506/2017, de 29 de setembro; updated by Despacho n.º 4034/2024, de 12 de abril
instruments.status: Em vigor (in force). Revokes POOC Ovar-Marinha Grande (RCM 142/2000). First POC approved.

instruments.name: POC-ACE — Programa da Orla Costeira Alcobaça-Cabo Espichel
instruments.diploma: RCM n.º 66/2019, de 11 de abril; Regulamento de Gestão das Praias: Aviso n.º 12492/2019, de 6 de agosto
instruments.status: Em vigor (in force). Revokes POOC Alcobaça-Mafra, POOC Cidadela-S. Julião da Barra, and POOC Sintra-Sado in the POC-ACE area.
instruments.notes: 224 km across 12 municipalities. The Tejo estuary margin (Oeiras/Lisboa) is outside POC scope — it awaits the never-approved Tejo estuary program.

instruments.name: POC-EO — Programa da Orla Costeira Espichel-Odeceixe
instruments.diploma: RCM n.º 87-A/2022, de 4 de outubro; retificada pela Declaração de Retificação n.º 26/2022, de 17 de outubro; Regulamento de Gestão das Praias: Aviso n.º 23368/2022, de 12 de dezembro
instruments.status: Em vigor (in force). Revises/replaces POOC Sintra-Sado (Espichel-Sado section), POOC Sado-Sines (whole), and POOC Sines-Burgau (Sines-Odeceixe section).
instruments.notes: ~476 km², 220 km of coast, 15 freguesias. Overlaps PNSACV between Porto Covo and Odeceixe, where POPNSACV (RCM 11-B/2011) also applies.

instruments.name: POC-OV — Programa da Orla Costeira Odeceixe-Vilamoura
instruments.diploma: Not approved. Elaboration resumed by Despacho n.º 9316/2019, de 3 de outubro (SEOT/Conservação da Natureza); earlier proposal had public discussion 7 jun–19 jul 2016
instruments.status: Em elaboração (in elaboration, NOT in force) as of mid-2026 — PCGT phase 'determinação do início', no public-discussion or approval dates set. Until approved, POOC Sines-Burgau (Odeceixe-Burgau section), POOC Burgau-Vilamoura and POPNSACV remain the applicable regimes.
instruments.notes: ~509 km², 210 km of coast. Will merge POOC Sines-Burgau (Odeceixe-Burgau) + POOC Burgau-Vilamoura. Status can change — CCDR Algarve/AMAL announced a 'retoma'; re-check PCGT before shipping.

instruments.name: POC-VVRSA — Programa da Orla Costeira Vilamoura-Vila Real de Santo António
instruments.diploma: Not approved. Elaboration determined by Despacho n.º 3841/2017, de 8 de maio
instruments.status: Not started substantively — PCGT phase 'a aguardar atribuição' (awaiting assignment) as of mid-2026. POOC Vilamoura-VRSA (RCM 103/2005, alt. RCM 65/2016) remains in force.

instruments.name: POE Tejo — Plano de Ordenamento do Estuário do Tejo
instruments.diploma: Never approved. Elaboration determined by Despacho n.º 21020/2009, de 18 de setembro (competence to ARH do Tejo), under Decreto-Lei n.º 129/2008, de 21 de julho (regime dos planos de ordenamento dos estuários)
instruments.status: NOT in force — only a preliminary proposal was ever produced; no approving RCM exists. Under Lei 31/2014/DL 80/2015 it would now be elaborated as a 'programa de estuário' (APA lists it as planned).
instruments.notes: For pdm: do NOT model any POE as an active constraint layer.

instruments.name: POE Douro — Plano de Ordenamento do Estuário do Douro
instruments.diploma: Never approved. Elaboration determined 2008/2009 under DL 129/2008; technical proposal advanced by ARH do Norte but no approving diploma was ever published in the DRE
instruments.status: NOT in force. APA now lists a future 'Programa de Estuário' for the Douro; nothing approved as of mid-2026. (APA's own page is ambiguous — documents/studies exist, but there is no approving RCM.)

instruments.name: POE Vouga — Plano/Programa de Ordenamento do Estuário do Vouga
instruments.diploma: None — never formally elaborated or approved
instruments.status: NOT in force; listed by APA only as a planned future 'Programa de Estuário' (Vouga/Ria de Aveiro)
instruments.notes: APA's planned estuary-program list is Douro, Mondego, Vouga, Tejo — the Mondego is also planned and equally unapproved. Zero estuary plans/programs are in force in Portugal.

instruments.name: POE Mondego — Programa de Ordenamento do Estuário do Mondego

instruments.name: PEPNSAC — Programa Especial do Parque Natural das Serras de Aire e Candeeiros (replacing POPNSAC)
instruments.diploma: RCM n.º 104/2023, de 1 de setembro (approved the updated limits + the Programa Especial + Regulamento de Gestão); accompanied by DL n.º 76/2023 amending the park's founding regime (first change to DL n.º 118/79 in 44 years)
instruments.status: em vigor since 2 September 2023 — the ONLY Programa Especial de Área Protegida approved to date; its content is to be transposed into the relevant PDMs
instruments.notes: The reference case for the whole POAP→PEAP transition. Park area ~38,400 ha.
